fusions.name: Ram Prow
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and rams it with a steel prow. The ram deals 30 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Trading Paint
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sideswipes everything in a cone 2.5 tiles long: it deals 8 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hatches Down
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coachwork Plate
fusions.desc: Conjures plating built to travel in: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and you move 4% faster.
